_comment: Bigness at its limit, four times what was tuned, wherever bigness is a thing the part can be: `colossal sun` the
star, `colossal trees` the wood, `colossal landmass` the ground, and a colossal Age every one of them but its creatures,
which only `colossal inhabitants` makes giants. The land leans to the landforms built big. The size axis is geometric, so the five steps -- minuscule, small, unsaid, large, colossal -- are equal.
